skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the basics of management control systems, including setting up internal control systems, establishing control centers, and implementing operational and strategic controls.
Develop the ability to analyze and solve practical problems in business control with flexibility and leadership skills.
Improve communication skills through group assignments and presentations.
Enhance teamwork skills by collaborating on group projects and presentations.
Develop independent research skills and adaptability to different work environments.
Apply knowledge to solve problems in business operations and strategic control.
Develop leadership skills through group projects and presentations.
Understand social responsibility and professional ethics.
Understand and apply financial control principles in business operations.
Apply operational control principles in business operations.
Apply strategic control principles in business operations.
Understand and apply internal control principles in business operations.
Apply human resource management principles in business operations.
Apply technology management principles in business operations.
Apply materials management principles in business operations.
Apply production control principles in business operations.
Apply sales control principles in business operations.
